description_en: Query the export directory information of the protocol service
description_zh: 查询协议服务导出目录信息
kebab_example: aliyun nas get-protocol-mount-target --next-token M18xMA== --max-results 20 --file-system-id cpfs-099394bd928c0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --protocol-service-id ptc-197ed6a00f2b0000 --export-id exp-19abf5beab8d0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetProtocolMountTarget

parameters.help_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of results for each query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the file system.

The IDs of CPFS file systems must start with `cpfs-`. Example: cpfs-125487\\.
The IDs of CPFS for Lingjun file systems must start with `bmcpfs-`. Example: bmcpfs-0015\\.
The IDs of CPFS SE file systems must start with `cpfsse-`. Example: cpfsse-022c71b134\\
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统ID。

CPFS：必须以`cpfs-`开头，例如cpfs-125487\\。

CPFS智算版：必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-0015\\。
CPFS  SE：必须以`cpfsse-`开头，例如cpfsse-022c71b134\\
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
A client-generated, case-sensitive token that you can use to ensure the idempotency of the request. The token must be unique for each request.

It must be an ASCII string with a maximum length of 64 characters. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性，从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html。

若用户未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the protocol service
parameters.name: protocol_service_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the export directory for the protocol service
parameters.name: export_id

NextToken.description_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
NextToken.description_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容

ProtocolMountTarget.description_en: Information of the export directory for the protocol service
ProtocolMountTarget.description_zh: 协议服务导出目录信息

AccessGroupName.description_en:
The name of the permission group.

Default permission group: DEFAULT\_VPC\_GROUP\_NAME
AccessGroupName.description_zh:
权限组名称。

默认权限组：DEFAULT_VPC_GROUP_NAME

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the export directory was created. Return format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
CreateTime.description_zh:
创建时间。
返回格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

Description.description_en: The description of the export directory
Description.example: 此协议服务导出的描述。

ExportId.description_en: The ID of the export directory

Path.description_en:
The path of the CPFS directory that was queried.

Format:

Must be 1 to 1,024 characters in length.
Must be encoded in UTF-8.
Must start and end with a forward slash (/). The root directory is `/`
Path.description_zh:
查询到的CPFS目录的路径。

格式：
长度为1~1024个字符。
使用UTF-8编码。
必须以正斜线（/）开头和结尾，根目录为`/`

ProtocolMountTargetDomain.description_en: The domain name of the export directory for the protocol service
ProtocolMountTargetDomain.description_zh: 协议服务导出目录的域名

ProtocolType.description_en:
The protocol type of the file system.

Valid values:

NFS: Network File System (NFS)
SMB: Server Message Block (SMB)
cpfs: The protocol type supported by the CPFS file system
ProtocolType.description_zh:
文件系统协议类型。

包括：

NFS：NFS文件协议
SMB：SMB文件协议
cpfs：CPFS文件系统支持的协议类型

Status.description_en:
The status of the export directory. Valid values:

CREATING: The export directory is being created.
AVAILABLE : The export directory is available.
MODIFYING: The export directory is being modified.
DELETING: The export directory is being deleted.
STOPPING: The export directory is being stopped
Status.description_zh:
协议服务导出目录的状态。包括：
CREATING：创建中。
AVAILABLE ：可用。
MODIFYING：修改中。
DELETING：删除中。
STOPPING：停止中

VSwitchId.description_en: The vSwitch ID of the export directory
VSwitchId.description_zh: 协议服务导出的交换机ID

VSwitchIds.description_en: The vSwitch ID list of the export directory
VSwitchIds.description_zh: 协议服务导出的交换机 ID 列表

items.description_en: The vSwitch ID of the export directory
items.description_zh: 协议服务导出的交换机ID

VpcId.description_en: The VPC ID of the export directory
VpcId.description_zh: 协议服务导出的专有网络ID
